text:
Elena (FP&A): Heads up — our week-long pricing experiment rolled out yesterday. Billing created ad-hoc promo credits for ~60 customers and a subset of partner invoices. Some credits are negative revenue adjustments. Close is Monday. Do we book an accrual for estimated credits or treat as post-close adjustments?

Priya (Billing): We have a hold flag `promo_experiment_review` on those credits pending legal sign-off. SQL extract shows total promo credit memos = $64,900 across 60 accounts. Sample memo: CM-2026-331: $1,200 promo credit for acct AC-7745.

Marcus (RevRec): Accounting standpoint: if credits reduce transaction price and are expected/per contractual, record contra-revenue accrual. If it's an operational promo (one-off) with uncertain issuance, could post as a period-end adjustment only when confirmed. Need an estimate + rationale.

Elena (FP&A): I ran a conservative estimate using historical uptake (45% of issued credits convert) => accrual $29,205. I can share calc.

Ethan (Controller): For audit, prefer to accrue if we can demonstrate a reliable estimate and policy. Proposed JE: Dr Sales discounts & allowances (4205) $29,205; Cr Accrued promotions (2510) $29,205. If we defer: Dr AR (1100) $29,205; Cr Deferred revenue (2100) $29,205.

Priya (Billing): Export SQL we used:
```
select id, account_id, amount, metadata->>'hold_tag'
from credit_memos
where metadata->>'hold_tag' = 'promo_experiment_review';
```
CSV with all rows uploaded to /shared/finance/close/experiment_promos_2026-03.csv.

Marcus (RevRec): Please include assumptions: historical conversion rate, date range, and which promo types were auto-granted vs manual. Also mark any partner-related credits separately.

Elena (FP&A): Action list: 1) Priya confirm partner vs end-customer split (by 10am). 2) Marcus & I finalize accrual calc and memo by 2pm. 3) Ethan to pre-approve JE for posting pending backup. 4) Post-close true-up scheduled next week.

close-bot: Reminder: Period close step 'post accruals' due in 36h. Link: https://redwood.internal/close/2026-03/tasks/47

Priya (Billing): Partner split = $18,700 partner-linked credits, $46,200 end-customer credits. I flagged 4 partner memos with disputes; those will be excluded from the estimate pending resolution.

Marcus (RevRec): After excluding disputed partner memos, revised accrual = $24,980. Draft memo uploaded: /finance/docs/accruals/2026-03/promo_experiment_accrual_memo_v1.docx.

Ethan (Controller): That looks reasonable. I'll sign-off once memo includes sampling of invoices and the SQL extract. Post accrual tag: CLOSE-ACCRUAL-2026-03-PROMO.

Elena (FP&A): Great — booking accrual unless disputes increase. Will update with JE # after posting. Thanks everyone.
